content.title: What AI Bubble? Vistra Makes A Powerful Run As AI Data Centers Fuel Nuclear Growth.
content.summary: After rocketing 258% higher last year — placing it among the top S&P 500 stocks and the best 100 stocks of 2024 — Vistra stock has galloped higher in 2025 amid the AI data center boom.  Nuclear giants Vistra and Constellation Energy are both up more than 30% in this year's stock market, continuing to build momentum since last year.  Analysts proclaim there is a "nuclear renaissance" underway.

content.title: Nvidia Has the Power to Move Markets. Watch These Sectors.
content.summary: It’s rare that a single company has the potential to move markets but Nvidia's earnings report has that power and will be key for multiple sectors.  The artificial-intelligence trade is the driver behind not just chip companies but also utilities, energy, cloud-computing and software stocks.  “Nvidia is the ultimate bellwether for the AI story and investors look to this company every quarter for reassurance that the AI story is still intact,” said Clark Bellin, president of wealth manager Bellwether Wealth.
